name: Ash
source:
"It's okay, because I'll protect you."

Lily's familiar. A werecat. He loves her from the bottom of his heart, but he's always getting swayed. Although he is more vigilant than anyone else, he protects those he envisions to the death.

[Translated from [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m03/character.html]official website[/url]]
